scenes.headline: Bronze Layer
scenes.subtitle: Raw, append-only landing zone of the medallion
scenes.narration: The bronze layer is the first stage of the medallion architecture, capturing raw source data exactly as it arrives.

scenes.headline: What bronze is for
items: Ingest raw data with minimal transformation
Preserve full history and original schema
Add ingestion metadata like load timestamp and source file
scenes.narration: Bronze captures data in its rawest usable form so nothing is lost. It preserves the original structure and complete history for reprocessing. Lightweight metadata such as ingestion time makes lineage and debugging easier.

scenes.headline: Bronze in the medallion
scenes.narration: Raw files and streams land in bronze without cleansing. From there, silver applies validation and enrichment. Gold finally aggregates business-ready metrics.

scenes.headline: Ingesting raw JSON into bronze
scenes.code:
from pyspark.sql.functions import current_timestamp, input_file_name

(spark.readStream
    .format("cloudFiles")
    .option("cloudFiles.format", "json")
    .load("/mnt/landing/clickstream/")
    .withColumn("_ingest_ts", current_timestamp())
    .withColumn("_source_file", input_file_name())
    .writeStream
    .format("delta")
    .option("checkpointLocation", "/chk/bronze_clickstream")
    .table("bronze.clickstream_events"))
scenes.narration: Auto Loader streams raw JSON from cloud storage into a Delta table. We tag each row with an ingestion timestamp and its source file for traceability. No schema enforcement or cleansing is applied yet, keeping bronze faithful to the source.

scenes.headline: Bronze best practices
items: Never mutate or delete raw records
Store schema drift rather than rejecting it
scenes.narration: Treat bronze as immutable so you can always replay downstream logic. Capturing schema drift avoids silent data loss when sources change. An append-only design keeps ingestion fast and inexpensive.

scenes.text: Bronze is your source of truth: raw, complete, and replayable.
scenes.narration: If a downstream bug corrupts silver or gold, a clean bronze layer lets you rebuild everything from scratch.
